description: This source file contains unit tests for the ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler class in the OpenMRS API, specifically testing the behavior of assigning visits to encounters during their creation.

classes.name: ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler during encounter creation, ensuring proper visit assignment logic.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the test database with specific encounter data before each test.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignExistingVisitIfMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that an existing visit is assigned to an encounter when a matching visit is found.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignNewVisitIfNoMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that a new visit is assigned when no matching visit exists.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignFirstVisitTypeIfMappingGlobalPropertyIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies default visit type assignment when no explicit mapping is provided.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignMappingGlobalPropertyVisitType
methods.description: Ensures that the visit type is assigned correctly based on a global property mapping.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldResolveEncounterAndVisitTypeUuidsAsGlobalPropertyValues
methods.description: Tests that UUIDs for encounter type and visit type are correctly resolved from global properties.
